RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-women panel does not itself indicate sex bias. Your longer experience and project leadership are relevant, but a group-head role may also prioritize client relationships, commercial development and people management. The announcement is not her complete résumé.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, and feedback on the decisive differences—not panel members’ sex.

If you uncover sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria or preferential treatment, document them and seek local employment-law advice promptly; claim deadlines can be short. Neither the panel’s composition nor the two-week silence establishes discrimination.
